public InputSettings(InputSettings.MouseSettings mouse, InputSettings.KeyboardSettings keyboard, InputSettings.GamepadSettings gamepad, int maxGamepadCount = 4, bool loadEmbeddedGamepadMappings = true, string? gamepadMappingsFilePath = null, List<string>? gamepadMappings = null)

Parameters

mouse InputSettings.MouseSettings

The mouse input device usage detection settings.

keyboard InputSettings.KeyboardSettings

The keyboard input device usage detection settings.

gamepad InputSettings.GamepadSettings

The gamepad input device usage detection settings.

maxGamepadCount int

Specifies the maximum number of gamepads supported by the input system. Setting this to 0 or negative values disables gamepad handling.

loadEmbeddedGamepadMappings bool

Indicates whether to load and apply the embedded gamepad mapping file on startup.

gamepadMappingsFilePath string

Absolute path to a text file containing gamepad mappings. Only used if loadEmbeddedGamepadMappings is false.

gamepadMappings List<string>

Additional gamepad mappings to apply at startup. Each string should represent a valid gamepad mapping.

GamepadMappings

Additional gamepad mappings to apply at startup. Works regardless of the value of LoadEmbeddedGamepadMappings and with GamepadMappingsFilePath. Each string should represent a valid gamepad mapping.

public List<string>? GamepadMappings

Field Value

List<string>

Remarks

These mappings are always applied after the embedded mappings (if LoadEmbeddedGamepadMappings is true) or after the mappings loaded from the file specified by GamepadMappingsFilePath. You can look at the format of the mappings in the default mapping file source: https://github.com/mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB/blob/master/gamecontrollerdb.txt for reference.

GamepadMappingsFilePath

Absolute path to a text file containing gamepad mappings. The entire file will be loaded and the mappings applied. Only used if LoadEmbeddedGamepadMappings is false.

public string? GamepadMappingsFilePath

LoadEmbeddedGamepadMappings

Indicates whether to load and apply the embedded gamepad mapping file on startup. If set to false, you can use GamepadMappingsFilePath to specify a custom mapping file. The default mapping file source is: https://github.com/mdqinc/SDL_GameControllerDB/blob/master/gamecontrollerdb.txt

public bool LoadEmbeddedGamepadMappings

bool

MaxGamepadCount

Specifies the maximum number of gamepads supported by the input system.

public readonly int MaxGamepadCount

Field Value

int

Remarks

Setting this to 0 or negative values disables gamepad handling. GamepadDeviceManager will not create any gamepad devices, even if gamepads are connected.
